data.overview: The only brand-specific sources fetched are SeventyOne's own website pages, which present it as a French natural, eco-responsible sunscreen and cosmetics brand emphasizing consumer respect and the fight against climate change. No independent assessments, legal matters, or third-party evaluations specific to SeventyOne appear in the fetched sources. The remaining sources concern unrelated companies (7-Eleven), general certification programs, or sector-wide ingredient/rating topics that do not name the brand.

claims.claim: SeventyOne positions itself as offering natural, eco-responsible cosmetics with fighting climate change as a core value.
